title: New consent-test comment cites payment_terms_acceptance CHECK idiom that this same PR documents as dropped
detail: The new test comment claims payment_terms_acceptance shares the 64/512 CHECK idiom, but PTA's CHECKs were dropped by the parity migration — contradicting this PR's own request_helpers comment. Doc-only; the test itself targets cookie_consent_log, which does carry the CHECK.
recommended_fix: Drop the payment_terms_acceptance reference from the test comment (e.g. "same CHECK idiom as application.submitted_*"), matching the corrected request_helpers.gleam documentation.
